thread_text:
Ava Li: Hi team! Ava here, joining Eng-Platform today. Laptop arrived but Jamf enrollment link didn't. VPN also errors. Who should I ping for SSH/org access? Two truths and a lie: 1) I ran a marathon, 2) I have a 6-year-old beagle named Mochi, 3) I once skydived. Guess which is the lie?

Riley - ops: Welcome Ava! I'll be your onboarding buddy. For repo access ping @Ben and drop SSH pub key in the access form.

Marta (IT): Hi Ava, Marta from IT. DM me the device serial and I'll resend the Jamf invite and manually approve. Which OS?

Ava Li: macOS Ventura, serial C02PL9XY1234. Jamf not in spam.

Marta (IT): Resent invite and approved. You should get the enrollment prompt in a few minutes. For VPN, try reinstalling the client after enrollment.

Ben - eng-platform: Hey Ava, I'm adding you to the org once the SSH key shows up. Example: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "ava.li@redwood.com"`

HR Bot: Reminder - complete benefits and payroll forms within 72 hours: https://intranet.redwood/onboarding

Ava Li: Update: Jamf invite arrived and device enrolled. Submitted SSH pub key. Mochi the beagle is real, marathon is true, skydiving is the lie :) Excited to be here!
